ValidationRule.description: US-29: an instalment sale reaching Payment Arranged (or Closed Won) needs a duration of 1-12 months and a down payment of at least 30% of the sale price. Fleet accounts may go below 30% (Head of Finance sign-off on the plan).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Payment Arranged"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Term_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Down_Payment__c)), OR( ISBLANK(Instalment_Term_Months__c), Instalment_Term_Months__c < 1, Instalment_Term_Months__c > 12, ISBLANK(Instalment_Down_Payment__c), AND(Instalment_Down_Payment__c < 0.3 * Sale_Price__c, Account.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Fleet_Corporate") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Instalment sale: enter the Instalment Duration (1 to 12 months) and a Down Payment Agreed of at least 30% of the sale price before Payment Arranged.
